records.relevance_note: Uses Claude prompts to pick a service to sell, build a 20-day plan, and land the first client (LinkedIn ghostwriting demo).

methods.name: Productized LinkedIn ghostwriting for SaaS founders via cold DMs and free-sample close
steps: Run prompt 1 in Claude: two ways to make first $1,000 in 30 days, using existing skills, no audience, sellable in 48 hours, with clarifying questions until 95% confident
Answer Claude's clarifying questions (background, hours, network, industry, skills, portfolio)
Pick one of Claude's two suggested paths
Run prompt 2: name the single most successful person to learn from (Justin Welsh)
Run prompt 3: have Claude role-play that person and make a 20-day plan under $1,000 with customer acquisition from day one
Days 1-3: build assets (polish your own LinkedIn profile) and a prospecting list of SaaS founders/CEOs via LinkedIn search
Days 4-10: send DMs and offer a free sample post written in the founder's voice
Close with a price (e.g. $500) without discounting; send a Stripe payment link
Use the bonus procrastination prompt to cut the plan in half and keep only money-making steps; track DMs on a sticky note
methods.tool_costs: Under $1,000 upfront total; LinkedIn Premium and a Stripe payment link mentioned as the main costs, no exact prices
methods.price_charged: Claude suggested a single yes could be $750; $500 used in the bonus-prompt example
methods.claimed_income: Creator claims an extra $15,000 in 10 days with under $1,000 invested, using these prompts; not tied to this specific service
methods.time_to_first_sale: 20-day plan to first paying customer; creator claims $15K in 10 days
methods.manual_work_evidence: Needs about 300 cold DMs, free sample posts, and a daily DM quota; 'the unsexy thing 300 times in a row, which is sending DMs'

warnings_caveats: The $15K claim is not substantiated and is not tied to a specific method in the video
The demo's income figures ($750, $500) are Claude's suggestions or hypothetical examples
Success depends on high-volume cold outreach and sales effort
Claude's recommendations depend on how much context it has about you
failure_modes: Not sending the DMs (biggest reason for failure per the creator)
Getting ghosted and quitting before the next DM
Discounting or over-justifying the price, and not tolerating silence after quoting
Over-consuming the mentor's content instead of doing outreach
Plans that put customer acquisition too late

key_quotes.quote: I'm going to show you three prompts I gave Claude to make me an extra $15,000 in 10 days with less than $1,000 invested upfront.
Give me two ways I could make my first $1,000 in 30 days. Both ways must require skills I already have, not require an audience, and be sellable within 48 hours.
Offer to write one post in their voice free no strings attached... Send it over and say, 'Hey, if you like it, post it. If you want more, hit me up.'
The skill isn't the writing. I already have that. The skill is doing the unsexy thing 300 times in a row, which is sending DMs.
Volume is a beautiful thing... volume gives you data and feedback faster.

records.summary: Sabrina Ramonov demos a chain of three Claude prompts, plus a bonus procrastination prompt, to choose a service, pick a mentor to model, and build a 20-day plan to a first $1,000 client. The live example is LinkedIn ghostwriting for SaaS founders, using cold DMs and a free-sample close. She claims $15K in 10 days from these prompts but shows no proof. The method needs heavy manual outreach.
